rows.source_description: ✅ frequency of lexemes
rows.rationale: This is a lexeme frequency statistic on both lexeme and word nodes, not a lexical sense, form, or a cross-corpus shared frequency.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review whether a source-defined statistic vocabulary/property is needed; preserve corpus counting scope.

rows.source_description: ✅ frequency of occurrences
rows.rationale: The occurrence-frequency integer is attached to word nodes and measures source tokens; it is not a lexical-entry identifier or a semantic relation.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review unit, scope and statistics vocabulary before ontology property mapping.

rows.source_description: ✅ word consonantal-transliterated (B R>CJT BR> >LHJM ...)
rows.rationale: The consonantal transliteration is a word-surface rendering, so its value cannot establish an OntoLex lexical Form identity or a lemma key.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review representation predicates and relation to explicit lexeme objects.

rows.source_description: ✅ word consonantal-Hebrew (ב ראשׁית ברא אלהים)
rows.rationale: The Hebrew-script consonantal rendering of a word is a written surface representation, not a separate lexical entry or sense.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review script/lang metadata and lexical-form representation predicates.

rows.source_description: ✅ lexeme pointed-transliterated (B.:- R;>CIJT B.@R@> >:ELOH ...)
rows.rationale: The pointed-transliterated lexeme realization occurs on word nodes; repeated text by itself is not a persistent Form object.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Verify linkage to the existing lexeme node and an OntoLex representation predicate.

rows.source_description: ✅ lexeme pointed-Hebrew (בְּ רֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹה)
rows.rationale: The pointed Hebrew realization of a lexeme is a representation string on words, not a separately identified lexical Form.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Verify lexical node relation, script and representation predicate against source.

rows.source_description: ✅ word pointed-transliterated (B.:- R;>CI73JT B.@R@74> >:ELOHI92JM)
rows.rationale: The pointed-transliterated word is token-specific (including reading details); treating it as canonical lexical Form would erase token versus lexeme scope.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review token-to-lexeme relations and language/script-aware representation.

rows.source_description: ✅ word pointed-Hebrew (בְּ רֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים)
rows.rationale: This fully pointed Hebrew word is a token rendering; identical Unicode strings cannot be assumed to identify one source Form.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review normalized/token-specific form semantics and script metadata.

rows.source_description: 🆗 english translation of lexeme (beginning create god(s))
rows.rationale: BHSA calls this an English translation of the lexeme, repeated on lex/word; the English text does not identify a lexical Sense or Concept.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Require independent source sense identity and concept authority before semantic promotion.

rows.source_description: ✅ of word or lexeme (Hebrew; Aramaic.)
rows.rationale: The source records Hebrew or Aramaic on word and lexeme nodes; a language label is not a LexicalEntry or a SKOS lexical concept.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Verify BCP47/ISO identity and suitable OntoLex linguistic metadata property.

rows.source_description: ✅ of word or lexeme in ISO code (hbo arc.)
rows.rationale: The feature contains hbo/arc language codes, which are metadata for the source object rather than evidence of lexical equivalence.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review standard code registry, scope and ontology language-property selection.

rows.source_description: ✅ lexeme consonantal-transliterated (B R>CJT/ BR>[ >LHJM/)
rows.rationale: BHSA supplies a consonantal transliterated lexeme string on lex and word nodes; this field is not itself the lex-node identity.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review explicit otype=lex identity binding and textual representation predicate.

rows.source_description: ✅ lexeme consonantal-transliterated without disambiguation (B R>CJT BR> >LHJM)
rows.rationale: The native description explicitly removes lexeme disambiguation; source values collapse distinctions and cannot serve as stable LexicalEntry identities.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Retain lexeme disambiguation and document source identity before any linking.

rows.source_description: ✅ lexeme consonantal-Hebrew (ב ראשׁית֜ ברא אלהים֜)
rows.rationale: Hebrew consonantal lexeme text is recorded on lex and word nodes; shared spelling is insufficient to equate lexeme entities.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Verify association with lex nodes and lexical-label/form representation.

rows.source_description: ✅ on words: the number of occurrences of its lexeme
rows.rationale: The source defines this word-level integer as the number of its lexeme occurrences, not a semantic category or lexical identity.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review counting definition and provenance before shared statistical publication.

rows.source_description: ⚠️ named entity type (pers; mens; gens; topo; ppde.)
rows.rationale: This source named-entity category on word/lexeme nodes (pers/mens/gens/topo/ppde) is not by itself a defined SKOS scheme.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review category definitions and whether an authoritative concept scheme exists.

rows.source_description: ✅ ranking of lexemes based on freqnuecy
rows.rationale: The rank integer orders lexemes by frequency in this corpus; it must not become a cross-corpus lexical equivalence or semantic class.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review tie handling, ranking scope and property semantics if represented.

rows.source_description: ✅ ranking of occurrences based on frequency
rows.rationale: The word occurrence frequency ranking is a corpus-local number, not an entry identity or shared lexical concept.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Verify ranking algorithm and source statistics semantics before promotion.

rows.source_description: ⚠️ root of word or lexeme (R>C CMH XCK <unknown>)
rows.rationale: The source calls this a morphological root of a word/lexeme and includes an unknown marker; it is not an OntoLex entry, sense or Decomp relation.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Require explicit root identity/association semantics and missing-value handling.

rows.source_description: ✅ vocalized lexeme pointed-transliterated (B.: R;>CIJT BR> >:ELOHIJM)
rows.rationale: The pointed-transliterated vocalized lexeme is a spelling/realization string on lexeme and word nodes, not a new Form identity.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review language/script-specific representation and lex-node linkage.

rows.source_description: ✅ vocalized lexeme pointed-Hebrew (בְּ רֵאשִׁית ברא אֱלֹהִים)
rows.rationale: The pointed Hebrew vocalized lexeme represents lexical material in Hebrew script; string equality cannot manufacture Form IDs.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review written representation semantics and native lexeme node identity.

rows.rationale: The R-005 inventory includes 9,230 lex nodes, an explicit TF lexeme entity kind distinct from word-level string features; this is a candidate OntoLex LexicalEntry.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Verify lex-node identity and linked slot occurrence semantics against pinned OntoLex LexicalEntry class.

rows.source_description: The text of a word in ETCBC transcription
rows.rationale: The source defines this as word text in ETCBC transcription; it is a token rendering, not a lexical-entry or sense identity.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review token-specific written representation against OntoLex semantics.

rows.source_description: The text of a word in estrangela script
rows.rationale: The Estrangela-script feature records the word text; a script variant cannot independently create a lexical Form object.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Review script metadata and token-to-lexical-form linkage.

rows.source_description: Realization of the lexeme in ETCBC transcription
rows.rationale: The source explicitly calls this a lexeme realization in ETCBC transcription on word nodes, not an independent lexeme entity.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Verify repeated-lexeme identity key before assigning form/entry relations.

rows.source_description: English gloss, not intended to be used for translation purposes
rows.rationale: The Syriac feature explicitly says English gloss is not intended for translation purposes; it cannot identify a sense or VarTrans translation.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Verify independent native sense IDs before any sense, concept, or translation assertion.

rows.source_description: Lexeme in ETCBC transcription
rows.rationale: The Syriac lexical string belongs to word nodes and no lex node is in the released TF version; equal lex strings alone do not prove entry identity.
rows.next_evidence_needed: Verify a stable source-sanctioned grouping rule and canonical lexeme key.
